status: Root-adjudicated source decisions; final import requires completed language reviews and verification.
review_scope: Main agent read the complete Chinese closing essay and each proposed Chinese/English correction. Reviewers read the complete assigned foreign manuscripts. Root checked selected primary methods and table footnotes, internal arithmetic, cross-episode consistency, and the August 2026 cutoff. This is not an exhaustive historical or legal audit. Every section, example, paragraph position, and the essay’s distinct final sentence is retained.

edits.zh: 这句话在这一组里已经出现过很多次。但放在最后一篇，它的位置不同了：它不再只是某一节的方法提醒。以 2010 年那两张披萨作为这组日常交易故事的起点，十六年后，它已经是贯穿这些故事的一条主要发现。
edits.en: That sentence has appeared many times in this series, but it occupies a different place in the final essay. It is no longer merely a methodological reminder within a section. Taking the two pizzas in 2010 as the starting point of this account of everyday transactions, sixteen years later it has become one of the findings running through the stories.
edits.reason: Explicitly anchor sixteen years to2010pizza rather than imply2009to2026is sixteen years.
edits.evidence_status: Calendar arithmetic; authorial anchor choice remains root decision.

edits.zh: 这不是谨慎，是必要。因为这段历史里许多重要的误判，不只来自算错，也来自把分母、时点或口径不同的数字放在一起比较。
edits.en: This is not merely caution; it is necessary. Many important misjudgments in this history came not only from calculation errors, but from comparing numbers with different denominators, dates, or definitions.
edits.reason: Do not claim nearly every serious error can be attributed only to denominator mismatch.
edits.evidence_status: Bounded methodological summary; no error-frequency dataset asserted.

edits.zh: 第七篇里那个八成是骗局，分母是项目数而不是金额。第十三篇里那些能耗数字，来自不同年份和不同模型。第十七篇里那个 120%，分母是按申请日低价固定的美元债权。第十八篇里那两个百分比，报道针对同一天，却采用不同的统计口径，相差约三十二个百分点。
edits.en: In Essay 7, the claim “eighty percent were scams” counted projects, not money. In Essay 13, energy figures came from different years and models. In Essay 17, the 120% used dollar claims fixed at depressed petition-date prices. In Essay 18, two figures reported for the same date used different measurement definitions and differed by approximately thirty-two percentage points.
edits.reason: 94.8minus63=31.8percentage points, roughly32not31; FTXdate not proven absolute low.
edits.evidence_status: Arithmetic and cross-episode consistency; EP18metric adjudication remains root responsibility.

edits.zh: 这些数字各自都有来源和计算口径；它们是否精确，还要分别核查。即使每个数都按自己的方法算对了，也不等于可以直接拼成同一本账。
edits.en: Each figure has a source and a measurement definition; its precision still needs separate checking. Even if each was calculated correctly under its own method, that would not make them directly combinable in one account.
edits.reason: A source and a method do not automatically certify every number as exact.
edits.evidence_status: Measurement qualification, no rejection of a particular source value.

edits.zh: 这些数字未必彼此冲突。每一个都有自己的方法、样本和来源；有的甚至出自同一家机构、同一份文件。要先核查它们各自算的是什么，再判断能不能放在一起。
edits.en: These figures need not contradict one another. Each has its own method, sample, and source; some even come from the same institution and document. First establish what each measures, then decide whether they can be used together.
edits.reason: Replace blanket none false with the actual comparability argument.
edits.evidence_status: Internal measurement scope.

edits.zh: 围绕 2025 年及相近的观察窗口，可以查到五组经常被放在一起的数字；它们覆盖的链、时间和对象并不完全相同。
edits.en: For 2025 and nearby observation windows, five frequently juxtaposed sets of figures can be found. Their chains, periods, and measured objects do not fully coincide.
edits.reason: Calendar-year and trailing-year measures are not necessarily identical windows.
edits.evidence_status: Internal consistency with following preceding-year and annualized descriptions; precise provider windows still need root verification.

edits.zh: 一个从链上广泛覆盖，再用模型筛选；一个从企业账目出发，能核对具体业务，却覆盖不全。把 4.2 万亿和 1,180 亿放在一起，算术上相差三十多倍；但这不是两组完全同口径的支付估计在争谁对，而是覆盖范围和分类方法都还没有对齐。
edits.en: One starts with broad on-chain coverage and filters through models. The other starts with company records, allowing concrete business activity to be checked but leaving incomplete coverage. The $4.2 trillion and $118 billion differ arithmetically by more than thirtyfold. That is not a disagreement between fully matched payment estimates: coverage and classification have not been aligned.
edits.reason: Do not imply30fold comparison is a shared-metric estimation dispute.
edits.evidence_status: Arithmetic and methodology distinction; original values preserved.

edits.zh: 相近的时期，不同的覆盖范围，同一类链上活动被不同方法重新分类。
edits.en: Nearby periods, different coverage, and the same broad class of on-chain activity reclassified by different methods.
edits.reason: Not necessarily the same transaction population or exact calendar year.
edits.evidence_status: Internal scope; DE/FR and ES/EN synthesis.

edits.zh: 不能只因为它们相差很大，就先判定其中必有一组算错；也不能只因为各有来源，就保证每一组都完全正确。
edits.en: Large differences alone do not establish that one calculation must be wrong. Separate sources do not guarantee that every calculation is entirely correct either.
edits.reason: Different definitions do not automatically prove every quoted estimate true.
edits.evidence_status: Methodological scope.

edits.zh: 因为选哪一个数，会决定人们怎样理解它。51 万亿很容易让读者想到全球支付系统的规模；5000 亿则像一个仍在起步的支付行业。但前一个是毛转账，后一个接近被识别的支付，不能把两者当成同一个问题的大小答案。
edits.en: Which number is chosen shapes how the system is understood. The $51 trillion may suggest the scale of global payments; the $500 billion may suggest an emerging payments industry. But the first measures gross transfers and the second approaches identified payments. They are not simply large and small answers to the same question.
edits.reason: Raw transfers cannot substantiate a payment-system size claim after the essay distinguishes those objects.
edits.evidence_status: Internal logical consistency.

edits.zh: 这些材料可以同时成立，前提是各自的标签没有被拿掉；如果把标签拿掉，两个看似相反的结论就可能只是两个不同问题。
edits.en: These accounts can coexist if their labels remain attached. Remove the labels, and two apparently opposite conclusions may simply be answers to different questions.
edits.reason: Preserve coexistence without endorsing contradictory claims about one metric.
edits.evidence_status: Necessary continuity after preceding correction.

edits.zh: 研究人员沿着 200 USDC 的跨境稳定币三明治逐段追踪：本国法币入金到交易所，买入稳定币，链上转账，对方交易所卖出，再提取当地法币。并非每条走廊都实际完成到银行到账；未完成环节的费用，另按公开费率估计。
edits.en: Researchers tracked a 200-USDC stablecoin sandwich: local-currency funding, purchase, transfer, sale, and withdrawal. Not every corridor reached a bank account; some unfinished-leg fees were estimated from published rates.
edits.reason: Banca d’Italia No86 methods and Table1/Table3 footnotes distinguish completed legs, estimated withdrawal fees, separately dated Wise simulations, and unavailable actual services.

edits.zh: 研究覆盖意大利与阿根廷、巴西、阿联酋、南非、日本之间的十个方向，日本另行分析，成本表比较其余八条走廊。表中稳定币交易主要记于 2026 年 3 月下旬，使用不同的发送方和接收方交易所，以免转账只是同一交易所的内部记账；Wise 的模拟报价则取自 4 月 14 日，并非同日对照。
edits.en: Ten directions linked Italy with Argentina, Brazil, the UAE, South Africa, and Japan. Japan was analyzed separately, leaving eight cost-table corridors. Late-March transactions used different sending and receiving exchanges to avoid internal transfers. Wise simulations were dated April 14, not the same days.
edits.reason: Banca d’Italia No86 methods and Table1/Table3 footnotes distinguish completed legs, estimated withdrawal fees, separately dated Wise simulations, and unavailable actual services.

edits.zh: 从发送方实际付出的本币金额出发，按官方汇率换算成美元，再减去收款端扣除各项费用后的美元等值，所得差额除以 200。已经完成的环节用实测值，未完成提现的环节则须注明估算，不能统称为银行账户实际到账。
edits.en: Costs were the difference between dollar-equivalent amounts sent and received, divided by 200. Completed legs supplied observations; unfinished withdrawals required labeled estimates, not claims of actual bank receipts.
edits.reason: Banca d’Italia No86 methods and Table1/Table3 footnotes distinguish completed legs, estimated withdrawal fees, separately dated Wise simulations, and unavailable actual services.; root English formula wording made explicit; all localizations already retain the difference.

edits.zh: 而阿根廷到意大利，稳定币路径为 8.96%；Wise 模拟显示 0.26% 到 0.31%，但研究也注明，当时并不实际办理这个方向。因此后一数字不是一条当时可用的替代路径。
edits.en: Argentina to Italy cost 8.96%; Wise displayed 0.26–0.31%, but did not actually serve that direction. Its quote was not an available alternative.
edits.reason: Banca d’Italia No86 methods and Table1/Table3 footnotes distinguish completed legs, estimated withdrawal fees, separately dated Wise simulations, and unavailable actual services.

edits.zh: 同一对国家，反方向，稳定币路径的成本已经完全不同；而要比较替代渠道，还得先问那条渠道是否真的能用。
edits.en: Reverse the direction, and stablecoin costs change completely. Before comparing alternatives, ask whether the alternative is actually available.
edits.reason: Banca d’Italia No86 methods and Table1/Table3 footnotes distinguish completed legs, estimated withdrawal fees, separately dated Wise simulations, and unavailable actual services.

edits.zh: 阿联酋那一对则整个反过来。去程稳定币路径估计为 7.20%，传统渠道模拟为 2.24%；回程 8.95%，传统渠道模拟为 1.02%。研究记录到，那一侧的银行卡入金附加费就达到约 3.8%。其中去程提现未实际完成，提现费按公开费率估计。
edits.en: The UAE pair reversed the advantage: outward, an estimated 7.20% versus 2.24%; inward, 8.95% versus 1.02%. Card funding added roughly 3.8%. The outward withdrawal was not completed; its fee was estimated.
edits.reason: Banca d’Italia No86 methods and Table1/Table3 footnotes distinguish completed legs, estimated withdrawal fees, separately dated Wise simulations, and unavailable actual services.

edits.zh: 而这不是某一条链比另一条链更好，也不是某一年比另一年更便宜。稳定币的八条走廊采用同类技术，在同一个月里追踪；传统渠道的模拟报价时间另列，不能把两组数当成同日、所有环节都实测完成的实验。
edits.en: This is not a comparison of different chains or years. The eight stablecoin corridors used similar technology within one month; separately dated conventional quotes were not a simultaneous, fully completed experiment.
edits.reason: Banca d’Italia No86 methods and Table1/Table3 footnotes distinguish completed legs, estimated withdrawal fees, separately dated Wise simulations, and unavailable actual services.

edits.zh: 这笔溢价反映的是当地美元需求、换汇限制和市场流动性等条件，不是区块链算法凭空创造的收益。通胀和资本管制是其中重要的背景，却不能仅凭一笔价格观察量出各自贡献了多少。
edits.en: The premium reflects local dollar demand, exchange restrictions, and market liquidity, rather than a return created from nothing by blockchain arithmetic. Inflation and capital controls are important context, but a price observation alone does not measure how much each contributed.
edits.reason: Avoid exclusive causal attribution while preserving premium-versus-technology distinction.
edits.evidence_status: Causal-inference qualification; no new empirical attribution.

edits.zh: 那个反事实不能被直接观察，但研究可以用实验、自然实验或其他明确假设下的方法去估计。这里缺的不是原则上永远不可能知道的另一个世界，而是足以回答这个具体问题的可靠识别。
edits.en: That counterfactual cannot be observed directly, but research can estimate it through experiments, natural experiments, or other methods under explicit assumptions. What is missing here is not knowledge forever impossible in principle, but reliable identification adequate to this particular question.
edits.reason: Unobserved counterfactual does not make causal identification impossible.
edits.evidence_status: Methodological logic, not a new claim of an identified effect.

edits.zh: 因此，对这里所引的许多材料，更合适的写法仍然是相关性，而不是已经量出的因果效应。相关性也有价值，只是不能替它多说一步。
edits.en: For much of the material cited here, association remains the more appropriate description, not a measured causal effect. Associations have value; they should not be made to claim an extra step.
edits.reason: Bound the claim to reviewed evidence, not nearly every causal claim in the entire field.
edits.evidence_status: Research-scope qualification.

edits.zh: 一句因果式的说法能不能成立，仍要回到研究怎样识别、控制了什么、还有哪些未排除的解释，不能只看它是不是容易传播。
edits.en: Whether a causal statement holds still depends on the identification strategy, the controls, and alternative explanations not excluded. Ease of circulation cannot decide that question.
edits.reason: Do not infer every widely circulated causal claim failed identification.
edits.evidence_status: Necessary methodological continuity.

edits.zh: 一个人在阿根廷买入美元稳定币，主要想取得的是美元计价、可转移的价值；这不等于他直接持有美国现金或银行美元，他仍承担发行人、储备和兑付的风险。他选择链上的版本，也可能是因为这条渠道对他更容易使用。
edits.en: Someone buying dollar stablecoins in Argentina chiefly seeks transferable dollar-denominated value. That is not the same as directly holding US cash or bank dollars: issuer, reserve, and redemption risks remain. The on-chain version may be chosen because that channel is easier to use.
edits.reason: Dollar demand does not make a stablecoin legally identical to dollars.
edits.evidence_status: Instrument distinction established in EP08 and EP20; no new individual motive asserted as universal fact.

edits.zh: 前一句讲的是需求，后一句讲的是渠道。把它们分开，才能既看见真实用途，也不把代币的风险抹成美元本身。
edits.en: The first point concerns demand; the second concerns the channel. Keeping them separate allows real uses to be seen without treating token risk as though it were simply the dollar itself.
edits.reason: Preserve demand/channel thesis while carrying the instrument qualification.
edits.evidence_status: Necessary continuity.

edits.zh: 这个区别很具体。前一句讨论特定条件下的自托管转账；后一句却把这种性质推到了整个日常支付流程。使用者走哪条路，决定了他会遇到哪一层的拦截和身份要求。
edits.en: The distinction is practical. The first statement concerns self-custodied transfers under specified conditions. The second extends that property to the entire everyday payment process. The route a user takes determines which layer's restrictions and identity requirements they encounter.
edits.reason: Do not assign unsupported tiny-minority versus vast-majority population shares.
edits.evidence_status: Scope qualification without new usage estimates.

edits.zh: 经过受监管交易所和银行出入金，是很常见的一条路，通常伴随身份核验；但这不等于每一次钱包之间的链上转账，都在两个端点重新核验身份。
edits.en: Using regulated exchanges and banks for on- and off-ramps is common and usually involves identity checks. That does not mean every on-chain transfer between wallets rechecks identity at both endpoints.
edits.reason: Distinguish ramps from every peer-to-peer transfer.
edits.evidence_status: Technical and regulatory mechanism distinction.

edits.zh: 第四篇里那个市场曾试图绕开正式制度。今天，稳定币这类大规模应用，又在发行、赎回、交易所和银行通道上接回了身份与合规安排；代币在这些端点之外怎样流转，则还要另看具体资产和网络。
edits.en: The marketplace in Essay 4 tried to operate around formal institutions. Today, a large-scale application such as stablecoins reconnects identity and compliance at issuance, redemption, exchanges, and bank channels. How tokens circulate beyond those endpoints still depends on the asset and network.
edits.reason: Remove almost-every-transaction KYC-at-both-ends claim.
edits.evidence_status: Internal mechanism consistency; DE/FR and ES/EN synthesis.

edits.zh: 缺一份完整数据库，不等于研究者没有权先把口径定义清楚。任何研究都可以说明哪些算破产、哪些算被盗、按哪一天估值、追踪到哪一年；难的是拿到足够完整、可比、持续更新的材料，并让这些定义被使用者正确理解。
edits.en: Lacking a complete database does not mean researchers have no authority to define their measures. A study can specify which cases count as bankruptcy or theft, the valuation date, and the follow-up period. The difficulty is obtaining sufficiently complete, comparable, continuously updated material and having users understand those definitions correctly.
edits.reason: Methodological definitions do not require compulsory global regulatory authority.
edits.evidence_status: Logical correction consistent with existence of cited datasets.

edits.zh: 而在这个领域，没有一家机构能够保证全世界所有相关主体，都按同一张表持续、完整地公开资料。
edits.en: In this field, no single institution can guarantee continuous, complete public reporting by every relevant actor worldwide under one common form.
edits.reason: Narrow lack of common reporting power rather than deny all dataset-building authority.
edits.evidence_status: Institutional scope; no new global reporting census claimed.

edits.zh: 银行、法院、监管者和破产管理人各自能要求一部分材料，却覆盖着不同主体、法域和程序；它们的记录不会因此自动合成一张全球账表。
edits.en: Banks, courts, regulators, and bankruptcy trustees can each require some records, but cover different entities, jurisdictions, and procedures. Their records do not automatically combine into a global account.
edits.reason: Preserve real institutional fragmentation without claiming no one has any relevant authority.
edits.evidence_status: Internal consistency with preceding detailed insolvency cases.

edits.zh: 这句话可以从两个方向读。一边是没有一个全球中心能替所有人决定一切；另一边是出了事以后，要把不同制度里的账接起来，仍需有人逐案做工作。开放性和对账成本，在这里同时出现。
edits.en: That can be read in two directions. There is no single global center deciding everything for everyone. Yet after a failure, connecting accounts across institutions still requires case-by-case work. Openness and reconciliation costs appear together here.
edits.reason: No universal center does not imply nobody is responsible for any failed platform's accounts.
edits.evidence_status: Necessary institutional continuity, not a new legal allocation.

edits.zh: 链上交易量就是支付量，已经比较明确地不成立。同一家机构在去掉部分重复和机器人之后，从超过 51 万亿得到约 10.2 万亿；另一些研究再识别支付用途，给出数千亿美元的量级。后者不是在同一数据集上再按一下筛选键，而是换了覆盖范围和识别方法。
edits.en: On-chain transaction volume is not payment volume. One institution reduced more than $51 trillion to about $10.2 trillion after removing some duplication and bots. Other studies identifying payment uses produced figures on the scale of hundreds of billions. Those are not another filter applied to the identical dataset; coverage and identification methods differ.
edits.reason: Do not attribute all stages to one provider's sequential filtering.
edits.evidence_status: Internal attribution consistency with section2.

edits.zh: 这三个案子表明，可见的资金流和最终结清的账之间，还隔着法律上的权利、技术上的追踪和现实的执行；不是把链上的路径画完，分配就会自己完成。
edits.en: The three cases show that visible money flows and settled accounts are separated by legal rights, technical tracing, and practical enforcement. Drawing the on-chain route does not make distribution complete itself.
edits.reason: Law matters alongside technology, not instead of it.
edits.evidence_status: Internal consistency with recovery processes described.

edits.zh: 真实支付量仍然没有一个可以包办全部用途的单一答案。围绕 2025 年和相近窗口，可以找到 28 万亿、4.2 万亿、三千多亿到五千多亿、3,900 亿，以及年化 1,180 亿等数字；其中有的是广义活动，有的是识别出的支付，还有的是企业样本的年化速度。现有证据足以否定链上流量全是支付，却还不足以给出一个精确的全球支付总额。
edits.en: There is still no single total covering all real payment uses. For 2025 and nearby windows, figures include $28 trillion, $4.2 trillion, a range from somewhat over $300 billion to somewhat over $500 billion, $390 billion, and an annualized $118 billion. Some measure broader activity, some identified payments, and one a payment-company sample's annualized run rate. The evidence rejects treating all on-chain flows as payments, but does not establish a precise global payment total.
edits.reason: Preserve all figures without relabeling all as same-year comparable payment totals.
edits.evidence_status: Internal definition and time-window consistency.

edits.zh: 从 2010 年那两张披萨算起，十六年了。
edits.en: Sixteen years since the two pizzas in 2010.
edits.reason: Make the intended sixteen-year narrative anchor explicit.
edits.evidence_status: Calendar arithmetic; optional authorial anchor proposal.

edits.zh: 它们已经记录并结算了大量转账，金额可以精确到各自协议规定的最小单位；公开链上的相应记录，也能按规则重新核验。前面列出的几十万亿是特定口径下的美元金额，不是几十万亿笔独立交易。
edits.en: They have recorded and settled large numbers of transfers, with amounts precise to the smallest units specified by their protocols. The corresponding public-chain records can be checked again under those rules. The tens of trillions quoted above are dollar values under particular definitions, not tens of trillions of individual transactions.
edits.reason: Correct transaction-count versus dollar-volume category error.
edits.evidence_status: Hard unit error identified by ES/EN and DE/FR; no invented cumulative count.

edits.zh: 相近时期，不同覆盖范围和分类方法，给出相差一到两个数量级的读数。
edits.en: Nearby periods, different coverage and classifications, and readings one to two orders of magnitude apart.
edits.reason: Do not repeat identical-year identical-transactions claim.
edits.evidence_status: Internal measurement scope.

edits.zh: 不能凭差额直接判错，也不能省掉口径直接相加。
edits.en: Their differences alone do not establish error, and their definitions cannot be omitted when combining them.
edits.reason: Replace none-wrong blanket endorsement with comparability conclusion.
edits.evidence_status: Internal methodological scope.

edits.zh: 不是因为懒，也不是说这个领域所有材料都不透明。公开链确实提供了少见的可核验账本，很多转账可以从历史记录重算；但交易所内部账、身份、法律权利和现实用途，不会因此一起变成同一种记录。
edits.en: Not because of laziness, or because every source in the field is opaque. Public chains provide unusually verifiable ledgers, allowing many transfers to be recalculated from historical records. Exchange internal accounts, identities, legal rights, and real-world purposes do not thereby become the same kind of record.
edits.reason: Public-chain verifiability does not include every custodial/internal transaction.
edits.evidence_status: Cross-episode scope, preserving transparency's value.

edits.zh: 如果把身份、用途和法域筛查都设成基础层每次转账的前提，这个系统就不再是原先那种无需事先许可的公共账本。其他制度当然也能存在、也能跨国运行；只是它们做出的，是另一组准入、责任和控制安排。
edits.en: If identity, purpose, and jurisdictional screening become prerequisites for every base-layer transfer, the system is no longer that original permissionless public ledger. Other systems can exist and operate across borders; they make a different set of arrangements for access, responsibility, and control.
edits.reason: Identity-aware or jurisdiction-aware systems are not inherently impossible or incapable of global operation.
edits.evidence_status: Logical scope; avoids contradiction with EP20's regulated products.

edits.zh: 它把适合放进协议的那部分算得越来越细；而许多链外问题，仍然没有同样完整、可以直接对照的总账。这不等于十六年里没有任何问题被解决，而是解决一类记录问题，并不会自动结清另一类人的处境。
edits.en: It has made the part suited to protocol rules increasingly precise. Many off-chain questions still lack an equally complete, directly comparable account. That does not mean no problem has been solved in sixteen years. Solving one kind of recording problem does not automatically settle another kind of human circumstance.
edits.reason: Remove universal no-off-chain-account-ever-settled claim.
edits.evidence_status: Research-scope qualification; preserves distinction between ledger precision and human outcomes.

edits.zh: 它是被标准明确留在管辖之外的那一整份清单；是有人答应了而没有进代码的那些承诺；是某种语法还没有办法表达的前提；是报价那一刻尚未知晓、结算时又早已离开那张屏幕的事情；是两条链之间还要额外核对的对应关系；是被合并掉的区分；是被请回来之后已经不完全是当初那一样的东西。
edits.en: The list a standard explicitly leaves outside its remit. Promises never written into code. Premises a particular syntax cannot yet express. Events unknown at quotation time and no longer on that screen by settlement. Correspondences requiring additional verification between chains. Distinctions merged away. Something brought back that is no longer quite what it was.
edits.reason: Keep closing cross-references consistent with reviewed EP09 and EP15; verification is additional, not fundamentally impossible.

edits.zh: 有第一篇那两张披萨到底对当时的人值多少，有第十三篇矿场搬走后那个县留下什么，有第六篇长期没有来申领、也许以后才出现的人。有第十一篇试图还款却迟迟没有进入区块、看着抵押品被近乎零价拍走的人，也有第十六篇原本为全租房押金存钱、后来遭受损失的年轻人。
edits.en: What the two pizzas in Essay 1 were worth to the people then. What remained in the county after the farms in Essay 13 left. People in Essay 6 who have not claimed for years but may still appear. The person in Essay 11 whose attempted repayment did not reach a block while collateral was auctioned near zero. The young person in Essay 16 whose savings for a jeonse housing deposit were hit by losses.
edits.reason: Synchronize claimant uncertainty and testimonial limits; do not invent proven fee poverty, permanent absence, or entire-deposit wipeout.
edits.evidence_status: Cross-episode evidence scope with corrected EP06,EP11,EP16.

edits.zh: 它最初要解决的问题很窄：让彼此不认识的人，不必依赖一个受信任的支付中介来处理每一笔转账。它确实做出了这样一条可公开核验的路径；这项成就不需要靠宣称所有第三方都已消失，或者所有场景都优于旧系统来成立。
edits.en: Its original problem was narrow: allow strangers to transfer value without relying on a trusted payment intermediary to process every transfer. It did establish such a publicly verifiable route. That achievement does not require claiming that all third parties disappeared or that every use outperforms earlier systems.
edits.reason: Match trusted-intermediary scope already accepted for EP01.
edits.evidence_status: Cross-episode conceptual precision; no universal performance ranking.

edits.zh: 2009 年初，这套协议首先提供的是价值转移的规则：让币能够在地址之间按规则转账。这不是说创世区块本身已经完成了一笔普通的地址间支付。
edits.en: In early 2009, the protocol first provided rules for transferring value: coins could move between addresses under those rules. That does not mean the genesis block itself completed an ordinary payment between addresses.
edits.reason: Do not attribute an ordinary transfer to the genesis block.
edits.evidence_status: Protocol-history precision; parent may verify or prefer the simpler first sentence only.

edits.zh: 而每一次它多结算一样东西，不能只看作技术自己变强了。
edits.en: Whenever it settles one more thing, that cannot be understood simply as technology growing stronger on its own.
edits.reason: Retain the institutional thesis without denying that technical advances also enable new settlement possibilities.

edits.zh: 技术进步让一些原本做不到的事成为可能；而那一次结算算数到哪里，仍要有人把权利、责任和接受条件接起来。
edits.en: Technical advances make previously impossible operations possible. What a settlement counts for still depends on people connecting rights, responsibilities, and conditions of acceptance.
edits.reason: Technical capability and institutional acceptance complement rather than exclude one another.

edits.zh: 人们先约定代码满足什么条件就该执行，链才按那些规则处理合约；人们先建立某个代币与美元的兑付关系，它才承载那种美元计价支付；人们先承认转让代理维护的记录是正式名册，它才承载那份基金份额。原生币的支付并不需要先等于一美元，每一类新增用途都有自己的约定。
edits.en: People first establish the conditions under which code should execute; the chain then processes contracts under those rules. They first establish a token's dollar-redemption arrangement; it can then carry that kind of dollar-denominated payment. They recognize a transfer agent's record as the official register; it can then carry those fund shares. Native-coin payments do not require first equaling one dollar. Each additional use has its own agreements.
edits.reason: Payments predate stablecoins; dollar parity is not a precondition for all payment functionality.
edits.evidence_status: Internal chronology and instrument distinction.

edits.zh: 所以，继续往外走的边界，不只在技术一侧。
edits.en: The boundary of further extension therefore does not lie on the technical side alone.
edits.reason: Human-agreement thesis need not deny technical limitations exist.
edits.evidence_status: Logical qualification preserving the next sentence's human focus.

edits.zh: 今天那些仍然算不清的事情，不能只用链还不够快、不够便宜或不够安全来解释。
edits.en: The questions still not fully accounted for today cannot be explained simply by saying the chain is not yet fast, cheap, or secure enough.
edits.reason: Technical performance can matter without being sufficient to resolve social measurement and distribution questions.
edits.evidence_status: Necessary continuity; avoids categorical technical exclusion.

edits.zh: 而这个位置在从披萨故事开始的十六年里一直在往前挪。每挪一次，既可能有技术打开新的路，也要有人把路上的权利、责任和接受条件谈清楚。
edits.en: That position has kept moving over the sixteen years since the pizza story. Each move may involve technology opening a new route; it also requires people to work out the rights, responsibilities, and conditions of acceptance along it.
edits.reason: Make the sixteen-year anchor and the nonexclusive technology/institution relationship consistent throughout the close.

21.label: Banca d’Italia No86 (July 2026): stablecoin remittance costs, methods and table notes

root_final_copyedits: §3 p6: Chinese/English formula explicitly states (amount sent − net amount received) / 200; DE/FR/ES/JA/KO already expressed this difference. No source-coordinate or argument change.
